blocks.content: Mira Studio was founded in 2019 by photographer Mira Chen in Portland, Oregon. With over 12 years behind the lens, Mira has worked with clients including Kinfolk, Patagonia, Bon Appetit, and a range of independent brands. Our philosophy is simple: great photography happens when people feel at ease. We keep sessions relaxed, intentional, and collaborative — because the best images come from genuine moments, not forced ones.
